records.works: One-line install.sh (standard); boots straight into Aerial (#3, adb reboot); HOME returns via guard (~0.5 s, no PatchWall flash since onPause pull-back for Android 12+); standby: firmware killAllThirdApp force-stops Aerial, notification listener RevivalListener rebinds in ~0.5 s and the guard returns to Aerial after wake (PatchWall visible briefly).
records.fails: HOME role / set-home-activity accepted but ignored (whitelist /data/system/mitv_security_center.xml); ADB switched off after wake (adb_enabled=0); Xiaomi screensaver is not a Dream.
records.route_reason: standard build installs with plain adb install; the firmware ignores HOME role / set-home-activity for packages outside Xiaomi's cloud whitelist (MitvSettings.isThirdpartyHomeAllowed), so HOME is taken by the accessibility guard that ships inside the standard build

grant WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS + notification listener (install.sh grant())
do NOT disable com.mitv.tvhome (FallbackHome then black-screens)
test HOME with the physical remote: adb input keyevent bypasses the accessibility key filter
